name: Donald Trump
bio: Donald Trump served as the 45th President of the United States from 2017 to 2021. A businessman and media personality, he won the 2024 presidential election and became the 47th President. He is a resident of Palm Beach, Florida.

name: Kamala Harris
bio: Kamala Harris served as the 49th Vice President of the United States from 2021 to 2025. Previously she was a U.S. Senator from California (2017–2021) and California Attorney General (2011–2017). She became the Democratic nominee after President Biden withdrew from the race in July 2024.

name: Rick Scott
bio: Rick Scott has served as U.S. Senator from Florida since 2019. He previously served as Governor of Florida from 2011 to 2019. Before entering politics, he was CEO of Columbia/HCA, the largest private for-profit healthcare company in the United States.

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
bio: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell represented Florida's 26th congressional district from 2019 to 2021. Born in Ecuador, she was the first South American-born immigrant elected to the U.S. Congress. Before entering politics, she worked in higher education and healthcare administration.
